subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

We are witnessing a __resurgence __of devilry that is perfectly appalling.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Failure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"resurgence"** means an increase or revival after a period of little activity, popularity, or occurrence. (पुनरुत्थान)

 
 
• **Example: **There has been a resurgence of interest in traditional crafts and arts.
 
 
 
• Failure (असफलता): Lack of success in achieving something.​
 
 
• Example: His failure to secure the contract was a big setback for the company.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'resurgence' **is **'**Failure **'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Failure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• "Return" refers to coming or going back to a place or situation. (वापसी)

 
 
• Example: After a long vacation, his return to work was welcomed by his colleagues.
 
 
 
• **Rebirth **(पुनर्जन्म): The process of being born again or renewed.
 
 
• **Example: **The festival symbolizes the rebirth of the sun and the start of a new year.
 
 
 
• **Triumph** (विजय): A great victory or achievement.
 
 
• **Example:** The team’s triumph in the championship was celebrated by all.
